correctness.rationale: At each of four binary 2-mer vertices the flow equations force B=E=x,D=G=y,C=t-y,F=t-x and n=A+H+x+y+2t. Positive x,y yield a connected 4-cycle; exactly one positive yields a connected 3-cycle with other loop absent; x=y=0 yields precisely the two unary loops or pure alternation. Eulerian existence is necessary and sufficient and these disjoint parameter cases give the series. Two finite geometric sums give the rational formula; the fifth-order pole at z=1 yields n^4/288 asymptotics. An independent vector-set enumeration for all 262142 binary words of lengths 1..17 and coefficients 1..80 agrees, not substituting for proof.
